title: Antiochus Epiphanes plunders the Temple
summary: Jones dates Antiochus Epiphanes plundering the Temple.
description: Jones dates Antiochus Epiphanes plundering the Temple. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed. Kevin ruled (2026-10-27) that this is not persecution-under-antiochus-iv. That persecution keeps its own sort.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 171 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: Not applied to persecution-under-antiochus-iv. The row does not cite a verse. The later line "Antiochus offers a sow on the altar" is on antiochus-profanes-the-altar.
